# The setting sun: a 12-sided disc 3.6 m across standing upright, facing the camera (-Y), and two long
# flat clouds. Unlit. Placed far behind the shore.
new
material new Sun --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392
material new Cloud --base-color 1.0000 0.8314 0.6392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.8314 0.6392
add mesh cylinder --name Sun --vertices 12 --radius 1.8 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Sun
add mesh cube --name C0 --size 1 --location -5.5 0.5 1.1
scale 5.0 0.2 0.45
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh cube --name C1 --size 1 --location -3.4 0.5 1.7
scale 2.6 0.2 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh cube --name C2 --size 1 --location 6.0 0.5 1.5
scale 4.2 0.2 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh cube --name C3 --size 1 --location 3.0 -0.3 0.4
scale 3.0 0.2 0.35
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
select Sun C0 C1 C2 C3
active Sun
join
select all
shade flat
export sun.glb
